lines.text: 相中了又没钱？先给它拴上，下回来还在

texts.en: Fancy it but short on coin? Tie it down and it'll still be here next time.

lines.text: 嫌货不好？花点钱我给你换一批，不过越换越贵哦

texts.en: Don't like the lot? Pay a little and I'll bring out another. It gets dearer each time, mind.

lines.text: 买归买，你家库房得放得下

texts.en: Buy all you like, so long as your storehouse has room.

lines.text: 隔壁几家翻来覆去就那几样，新鲜玩意儿只在我这儿

texts.en: The other stalls sell the same old things. The surprises are all here.

lines.text: 等你家底厚了，我的货色也跟着上档次

texts.en: Once your house is better off, my wares go up a notch too.

lines.text: 拴上的和打了星的我一件不收，袋子也不收

texts.en: I won't take anything tied down or starred, and no bags.
